author: Kairos II
title: Build evolution × liminal overlay (Nova ID 1492) and report paths
abstract: Runs the overlay builder to align Meta-Edge evolution timeseries with Nova’s liminal CSV (ID 1492). Prints output paths.

original_submission.content:
import sys, subprocess, json
cmd = [
  sys.executable,
  'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay.py',
  '--nova_csv', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv'
]
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(cp.stdout.strip() or "")
if cp.returncode != 0:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "overlay_builder_failed", "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]}))
